_catalog_note: Beastman tier - not in setting-lore §5.2; demographics from ax_domains_of_chaos.xml (catalog 5.3). Naming/totemic flavor only.
sub_palette: ogre (Kazhur regressed - deep booming bellows + grunts)

branch.regression: deep booming bellows + grunts (simple CVC only, booming b/g/d/m, vowels low o/u, suffix -og/-grub/-mog)
branch.nature: huge dim brutes; man-eaters and skull-smashers; few, heavy words
branch.model: Kazhur rotted into an ogre's booming grunt

_note: Beastman culture: OGRES, huge dim brutes - Kazhur rotted into deep booming bellows and grunts (qatal 'kill' -> Gatog). Man-eaters and skull-smashers; the fewest, heaviest words. ALWAYS CHAOTIC; totemic shamanism (race-totem the Great Gut / the Boulder-Fist). Deity-morphs Gul- prefixed. Mechanically stripped (catalog 5.3).

phonology.palette: Ogre (Kazhur, boom-grunt regression): simple CVC only, booming voiced b/g/d/m, vowels low o/u, suffixes -og/-grub/-mog; few, heavy, bellowed words.
phonology.phonotactics: heavy CVC; booming low stress; minimal vocabulary.

morphology.naming_marker: named with a bellow by the gashob; a heavy grunt-name.

title_ladder._note: Mapped to the ACKS 7 civ tiers (the shared system; not a perfect fit) by how many clanholds a leader rules - barony = chief of one clanhold (lowest governing leader), empire = the great horde-lord over hundreds. thrall/warrior are NOT governing roles (see non_governing_ranks).
title_ladder.government: clanhold / ogre-band - small, brutal (mapped to the civ 7-tier ladder by clanholds ruled)

march.scope: war-chief of a frontier / raiding clanhold

empire.scope: the great horde-lord over hundreds of clanholds

religion._note: CHAOTIC, totemic, and simple. Race-totem the Great Gut / the Boulder-Fist. The Gashob bellows to the totem and the Gul-spirits over the bone-pit; foremost Gul-Maraqus the War-Spirit (the smash) and Gul-Waqidu (the endless gut). The One and the sun demonized. Few gods, few words.
religion.shaman_rites: bellow-chants over the bone-pit; the cracking of skulls for the totem; the eating-feast.

holy_symbol_motifs.Great Gut: a vast belly over cracked bones
holy_symbol_motifs.Boulder-Fist: a great fist crushing a skull

banks_patterns.war_bands: the boom-named bands: 'the Skull-smashers', 'the Man-eaters', 'the Boulder-fists of [chief]'
banks_patterns.lairs_dungeons: boulder-caves, bone-pits, and mires: 'the Smash-cave of [band]', 'the Bone-pit of [chief]', 'the Man-eater's cave of [name]'
